title: Interactive 3D Electrostatic Nanotweezer Simulator
summary: Web-based 3D simulator of a carbon-nanowire electrostatic nanotweezer that reproduces a COMSOL benchmark: live voltage sweep, pull-in detection, field lines, parametric study, CSV export and gesture control.

title: Improved Fuzzy Controller for Electromechanical Nano-Tweezers
summary: A fuzzy control strategy for regulating the nonlinear, pull-in-prone dynamics of electrostatically actuated nano-tweezers.
supervisor: Dr. Ali Koochi; Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh; Dr. M.R. Gharib

title: Dynamic Modeling of Three-Finger Micro-Tweezers
summary: Mathematical model of a three-finger micro-tweezer for grasping micro-particles, comparing its gap and pull-in behavior with a two-finger design.
supervisor: Dr. M.R. Gharib; Dr. Ali Koochi; Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh

title: Robust QFT Control of a Rotational Nanoscanner
summary: Quantitative-feedback-theory design for the coupled torsion/bending dynamics of a multivariable rotational nanoscanner.

title: Electrically Actuated NEMS Biosensor in Magnetic Flux
summary: Nonlinear dynamics of an electrostatically actuated cantilever biosensor in a magnetic field — dynamic pull-in, bifurcation and sensitivity enhancement near pull-in.
supervisor: Dr. Ali Koochi; Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh

title: Review: Control Methods for MEMS/NEMS
summary: A comprehensive review of classical, robust, intelligent and learning-based control approaches applied to micro- and nano-electromechanical systems.
supervisor: Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh; Dr. Ali Koochi

title: ML Surrogate for Fast Pull-in Prediction of Casimir-Driven Nanoswitches
summary: Replace repeated GDQ/MAD solutions with a trained neural network that predicts the pull-in threshold instantly; validated against GDQ and FEM.

title: Fractional Nonlocal Vibration of Graded Viscoelastic Nanobeams
summary: Generalize nonlocal elasticity to fractional-order derivatives to capture memory effects in viscoelastic functionally graded nanobeams.

title: PINN for Dynamic Instability of Nanobridges with Surface & Size Effects
summary: Physics-informed neural networks that solve the governing nonlinear equations of a nanobridge directly from the PDE residual.

title: Topology-Optimized Multi-Stage Compliant Micro-Gripper
summary: Design and topology optimization of a compliant micro-gripper with high displacement amplification for micro-particle manipulation.
supervisor: Dr. Ali Koochi; Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh

title: Auxetic Metamaterial as a Compliant Element in Electrostatic Nano-Actuators
summary: Exploit negative Poisson's ratio micro-structures to tune the stability of nano-actuators under intermolecular forces.

title: Multi-Axis Flexure Mechanism for a Piezoelectric Nano-Positioner
summary: Analytical–numerical model of a multi-axis flexure hinge stage for precise piezo-driven nano-positioning.
supervisor: Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh; Dr. Ali Koochi

title: Dual-Frequency Nonlinear Energy Harvesting under vdW / Casimir Forces
summary: Nonlinear dual-frequency harvesting from a nano-resonator whose stiffness is tuned by intermolecular forces.

title: Geometry Optimization of a Micro Piezoelectric Harvester with Surface Effects
summary: Optimal geometry of a micro-scale piezoelectric harvester using the Gurtin–Murdoch surface-elasticity model.

title: Hybrid Electrostatic / Triboelectric Harvester for Self-Powered Sensors
summary: Combined transduction mechanisms modeled with a nonlinear continuum framework for self-powered IoT sensors.
supervisor: Dr. Ali Koochi; Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh

title: Nonlinear Vibration of Pre-Tensioned Multilayer Graphene Membrane Resonators
summary: Nonlinear dynamics of multilayer graphene membranes under pre-tension and electrostatic coupling.

title: Electromechanical Stability of MXene Sensors with a Surface Bilayer Model
summary: Pull-in stability of MXene-based sensors using an anisotropic Gurtin–Murdoch bilayer model.

title: Dynamics of Topological-Material Nanoswitches in a Magnetic Field
summary: Dynamic modeling of nanoswitches made of topological materials actuated in the presence of a magnetic field.

title: Reinforcement-Learning Control Beyond Pull-in for a Nano-Positioner
summary: An RL agent (PPO / DDPG) that stabilizes an electrostatic nano-positioner beyond the classical pull-in limit, compared with robust QFT control.
supervisor: Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh; Dr. Ali Koochi

title: Digital-Twin Architecture for Fault Prediction of an Electromagnetic Nano-Resonator
summary: A real-time digital twin built on a reduced-order model for monitoring and failure prediction of an electromagnetic nano-resonator.
supervisor: Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh; Dr. Ali Koochi

title: Multi-Objective Optimization of an Electrothermal MEMS Actuator with ML Surrogates
summary: Surrogate-assisted NSGA-II optimization of an electrothermal MEMS actuator.
supervisor: Dr. Ali Koochi; Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh
